summary.oneLiner: A commodity-focused group supplying minerals (Barite, Fluorspar, Copper Cathode) and manufacturing rice bran oil, with operations across India, Morocco and Singapore.
summary.business: Sri Priyanka Geo Commex Limited supplies minerals - Barite, Fluorspar and Copper Cathode - to industries spanning energy, chemicals, infrastructure and electronics, with the India Barite/Fluorspar business run by the Company and the international business run through its Singapore subsidiary Geo Min Commodities Pte. Ltd and its Morocco step-down subsidiary Atlas Resources International.
